record.title: Reconcile reader evidence and the next physical parity question
record.intent: Decide whether the helper is suitable for a separately authorized observation and preserve explicit remaining limits.
requirements: Evaluate addressing, repeated bytes, process lifetime and permission evidence separately. A guest pass cannot establish specimen permissions or initialized physical values.
State the smallest proposed future physical action, including any temporary helper staging, existing-credential requirement, maximum memory bytes and stop-on-denial rule. Do not execute it overnight.

If the control fails, close the actual question and admit a bounded successor only when justified. Otherwise release reporting; avoid repetitive synthetic permutations that cannot answer the physical parity question.
Commit and push the decision and any admitted successor before execution.
acceptance: A bounded physical proposal or exact unresolved control dependency is recorded without specimen contact.
